interface.signature: getMaxRepetitions(s1: str, n1: int, s2: str, n2: int) -> int

preconditions.description: s1 and s2 must be strings.
n1 must be an integer between 0 and 10^6 inclusive.
n2 must be an integer between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.
s1 must be a non-empty string with at most 100 characters.
s2 must be a non-empty string with at most 100 characters.

postconditions.description: The return value must be an integer.
The return value must be the maximum integer M such that [S2, M] can be obtained from S1.
